Overview.Name: Hussain Aruva
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, Healthy weight gain and strength improvement
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (150 g) & chicken soup + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (150 g) & egg bhurji (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (150 g) & vegetable curry + grilled chicken (120 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid all dairy products including milk, curd, paneer, butter, cheese and whey protein.
Since the goal is healthy weight gain, avoid skipping meals and maintain consistent meal timing.
Choose simple home-cooked foods rather than highly processed or fried foods.
Get 20–30 minutes of morning sunlight exposure daily.
Try to include a short walk after meals to support digestion and recovery.
Regular yoga, proper sleep and consistent eating habits will support healthy weight gain and energy levels.
